name: show-all-entity-data-tests
description: Playwright test harness for the ShowAllEntityData userscript

scripts.test:live:report:artist-releases: PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME=test-results/artist-releases-report.json playwright test tests/live/artist-releases-filter-sort.spec.js --project=chromium-live --reporter=list,json; e=$?; node tests/support/generate-filtersort-report.js < test-results/artist-releases-report.json; exit $e
scripts.test:live:artist-releases:full: TEST_PREFILTER_LOAD=1 TEST_COLVIS=1 PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME=test-results/artist-releases-full.json playwright test tests/live/artist-releases-filter-sort.spec.js --project=chromium-live --reporter=list,json; e=$?; node tests/support/generate-filtersort-report.js < test-results/artist-releases-full.json; exit $e
